svg.title: S2GO temporal transformer with Ego-Transform on past queries
svg.desc: Decoder layer matching the code. Past queries pass through an Ego-Transform that compensates for ego-motion before entering self-attention. Self-attention shows Q from current only while K and V come from the concatenated stream. Cross-attention receives init_xyz as reference points fixed across all six layers. FFN includes the second dropout. Block repeats six times.

g.text: Paper-spec configuration: T_queue=4 → 1024 past slots. Barebones config has T_queue=1 → past stream effectively empty.
Opacity-δ propagator pushes top-256 back to memory queue
